d.t: WALL SPACER FOR SAFETY PANEL SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVING FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiScape Wall Spacer is an accessory to create a gap between the raised safety panel and the surrounding parapet wall. Wall spacers are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it has a compressible buffer to accommodate the expansion and contraction of materials under thermal influence. SikaRoof VersiScape Wall Spacer is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiScape Panel and is installed between the panels and the finishes.
a: Wall buffer for raised safety panel system
Resistant to biological attack by mounds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Wall spacer for safety panel with raised paving installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
d.pk: SikaRoof VersiScape Wall Spacer Refer to pricelist

sec.t: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.
Product must be stored in their original packing, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
Spacer Tab Thickness 4 mm Wall Spacer Gap 10 mm

Clean and sound surface shall have at least a wood float finish. All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure. High spots in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be cut off or ground down to prevent damage/puncture to the pedestal base.

SikaRoof VersiScape Wall Spacer shall be installed with SikaRoof VersiScape Panels. SikaRoof VersiScape Wall Spacer shall be placed on top of the corners of SikaRoof VersiScape Panel, along the perimeter of the raised flooring installation before placing stone, concrete or porcelain pavers.
